root_cause.escaped_defect: A stale delivery writer could still rewrite an open PR branch from an older lease snapshot before the terminal merge guard rejected the stale main epoch.
root_cause.example: Retired #3861 repeatedly reintroduced older Supabase workflow source while current main had already advanced.

prevention.terminal_candidate: Writer-Lease-State TERMINAL_DELIVERY makes the candidate branch content-immutable.
prevention.preterminal_cas: Every branch mutation must match both expected current head SHA and captured current-main epoch.
prevention.drift: Any head or main-epoch drift returns CREATE_SUCCESSOR_FROM_CURRENT_MAIN; stale snapshots are never replayed onto the existing PR branch.
prevention.merge_guard: Exact-head checks and current-main terminal merge admission remain independently fail-closed.

evidence.invariant: A terminal candidate is content-immutable; stale head or main epoch requires a successor from current main.
